what: Intel designs and manufactures processors for PCs and servers and is building a contract chip-manufacturing business (Intel Foundry) to make chips for others.
customers: PC makers (Dell, HP, Lenovo), cloud and server companies, and potential foundry customers.
money: Core processors for laptops and desktops
manufacturing services, Altera and Mobileye (partly sold or spun off)
moat: Large manufacturing capacity in the US and Europe, a huge installed base and government support for domestic chipmaking.
rivals: Arm-based chips from Apple and Qualcomm
risks: Lost market share and manufacturing delays
Very heavy spending on new factories
